instruction: Use Visual Studio Code to access the workspace stored at /home/user/workspace1.code-workspace.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening workspace1.code-workspace in VSCode. The evaluator verifies: (1) VSCode is running (20% score), (2) workspace1 is actually opened in VSCode by checking accessibility tree (40% score), (3) the workspace file exists on the VM (20% score), (4) it's valid JSON (10% score), and (5) it contains the expected folder path './project1' (10% score). Custom getter checks VSCode's actual state via accessibility tree to verify workspace is loaded, not just file existence. Custom metric validates both VSCode state and file content.
